<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-52" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="111.121.1 mtshan nyid"/>
         dang po la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> yul can shes pa la gsal bar snang pa dang | yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres par snang pa dang | don byed nus par snang ste khyad par 3 dang ldan pa mtshan nyid yin no zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | don byed nus par snang bas <lb n="2a3"/> rigs mi mthun thams cad bcad pas dang po 2 la rnam gcad myed la mtshon bya'i don ldog kyang ma yin te | med pa gsal ba la yang mtshan nyid dang po 2 zhugs pa'i phyir ro || 
         'o na gang zhe na 
         'dzin pa ma 'khrul pa la snang du rung pa mtshan nyid do || 
         de la snang rung gis ni gzung yul du mtshon la ma 'khrul pa la snang du rung bas ni med pa gsal ba dang don spyi bcad nas <lb n="2a4"/> don rang mtshan du mtshon no | </seg></TEI>
